title: registry.user.changed payload (v1)
description: User created/updated/role-changed/disabled. Ids and changed field names only; no secrets or password data. Producer: registry. Exchange: aegispulse.domain. FRs: FR-TEN-04, FR-TEN-05, FR-AUD-02. Describes only the envelope `payload` (PROJECT.md §6.4, §6.7); consumers ignore unknown fields (NFR-13).
